layers.title: Live layers
welcome.title: What is this?
welcome.intro: tutka watches Nordic/Baltic-Russia tension: what is unusual right now, and what that means for everyday life in Finland.
welcome.editorial: The deviation index and its bands are our own published formula on top of GDELT news data — versioned and fully explained under "How is this computed?".
welcome.bestEffort: Live ship AIS and flights (Gulf of Finland/Baltic region), news volume/tone (GDELT, rate-limited). Gaps are shown, never hidden.
welcome.footer: A one-person civic hobby project on free public data. Not navigation or trading advice.
timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.explainer: Every series we hold real history for, overlaid on one shared scale so you can see what moves together — hover any line for its real value and unit, click a legend entry to hide it. Dashed lines mark hand-curated events. Ships/flights history only started accumulating on launch day, so those two are short for now.
dashboard.calmBody: All {n} reporting domains sit inside their normal range for the past 30 days.
dashboard.baselineNote: Each domain is scored against its own trailing 30 days, not a fixed threshold — so “normal” means normal for that domain.
card.quiet: unusually quiet — may be a thin or degraded feed
climate.mapEmpty: No active-fire hotspots returned for this region right now.
domain.2.concept: "Hybrid" and "grey-zone" refer to state-linked activity that deliberately stays below the threshold of open conflict — deniable and hard to trace by design.
events.title: Event log
events.explainer: Every band change, deviation spike, and advisory item across all domains — timestamped and permalinked. The site's memory: what moved, and when.
events.notFound: That event doesn't exist — it may have been pruned, or the link is wrong.
